description: Header file defining classes and functions for building complex binary data streams, including label management, section construction, and data appending methods, used for testing the Breakpad symbol dumper and processor.

classes.name: Label
classes.description: Represents a label with a value that may be undefined, a constant, or related to other labels, used for referencing positions within binary sections.

classes.name: Section
classes.description: Represents a sequence of bytes with methods to append data in various formats, manage labels, and generate binary content for testing purposes.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Methods to append raw data, strings, or labels to a section.

methods.name: LEB128
methods.description: Appends a signed LEB128 encoded integer to the section.

methods.name: ULEB128
methods.description: Appends an unsigned LEB128 encoded integer to the section.

methods.name: Align
methods.description: Aligns the section size to a specified boundary, filling with a padding byte.

methods.name: GetContents
methods.description: Retrieves the section's contents as a string if all label references are resolved.
